objects.text: The stone by the door reads:^{g}'AMAT. SHE KEPT A CLEAN HOUSE.'{/}| Somebody has swept round the foot of the stone, in a circle, as far as a broom will reach.~~In the dream the stone is smooth and blank.^Nobody is under it to say otherwise.

The stone by the door reads:^{g}'A SHEPHERD. HE NEVER LOST ONE.'{/}| Lower down, in the same hand, later: {g}'HE HAS LOST COUNT.'{/}~~In the dream the stone is smooth and blank.^Nobody is under it to say otherwise.

Bricked up from the inside, and never pointed.^He went in and had it closed behind him, so that nobody could come and stand level.| The steps up the front are for the neighbours to look at. The hatch in the roof is for the man who sweeps it.

The stone by the door reads:^{g}'KI-AG. HE LOOKED UP TO NOBODY.'{/}| It is a hand taller than any other stone on the road. It has been measured.~~In the dream the stone is smooth and blank.^Nobody is under it to say otherwise.
on:nr_couple_latch
objects.who: door|Bolted, on the inside. Through it, in whispers: an argument about whose turn it is to lie on the left.^Nobody is coming to the door until that is settled.| The dead do not dream. Asleep, there would be nobody behind this door to keep it shut.
objects.say: The bolt is drawn, and the door of the two vaults stands open.^The argument has moved on to who left it open.

objects.text: The stone by the door reads:^{g}'THEY WERE NEVER PARTED.'{/}| Under it, scratched from the inside, by the look of it: {g}'NOT FOR WANT OF ASKING.'{/}~~In the dream the stone is smooth and blank.^Nobody is under it to say otherwise.
plate:nr_weigh
objects.say: The grille of the assessor's vault goes up.^It has been waiting three hundred years to hear the end of this.

objects.text: shekels:120

{g}THE ASSESSOR OF THE DEAD.{/}^{t}DEBTS ARE WEIGHED HERE. THE VAULT OPENS TO WHAT IS OWED, WHEN IT COMES TO BE WEIGHED, OR TO THE NEWS THAT IT IS PAID.{/}| Scratched under it: {t}I STOOD ON THE PLATE. I AM OWED PLENTY. NOTHING.{/}

A sheep, cut in stone, the size of a sheep.^He had six made, so that he would never be without them. People leave them a little grass, to be kind.~~In the dream it is a stone, and has never looked like anything.

A sheep, cut in stone, the size of a sheep.^He had six made, so that he would never be without them. People leave them a little grass, to be kind.~~In the dream it is a stone, and has never looked like anything.

A sheep, cut in stone, the size of a sheep.^He had six made, so that he would never be without them. People leave them a little grass, to be kind.~~In the dream it is a stone, and has never looked like anything.

The barrow of the house of Dur. The door has been kicked open from the inside.~~In the dream there is nobody behind the door.^The dead don't dream. Asleep, the hill is very quiet.~~Snoring.^From behind every door on the hill, at last: snoring.

A barrow. Somebody has scratched on the lintel: {g}'DO NOT KNOCK. I AM TRYING.'{/}~~In the dream there is nobody behind the door.^The dead don't dream. Asleep, the hill is very quiet.~~Snoring.^From behind every door on the hill, at last: snoring.
stele
The stone reads:^{g}'HE ROSE EVERY DAY OF HIS LIFE. NOT TODAY.'{/}~~In the dream the stone is smooth and blank.^Nobody is under it to say otherwise.
The stone reads:^{g}'ENBI-ISHTAR. OWED NOTHING. OWNED LESS.'{/}~~In the dream the stone is smooth and blank.^Nobody is under it to say otherwise.
The stone reads:^{g}'TO MY HUSBAND. I TOLD YOU SO.'{/}~~In the dream the stone is smooth and blank.^Nobody is under it to say otherwise.
The stone reads:^{g}'SHE KNEW WHERE EVERYTHING WAS.'{/}| Under it, in another hand: {g}'NOW NOBODY DOES.'{/}~~In the dream the stone is smooth and blank.^Nobody is under it to say otherwise.
The stone begins, in a careful hand: {g}'KUBABA, BELOVED...'{/}^The rest has been eaten. There are tooth marks.~~In the dream the stone is smooth and blank.^Nobody is under it to say otherwise.
The stone reads:^{g}'PLOT RESERVED. DO NOT BE BURIED HERE.'{/}~~In the dream the stone is smooth and blank.^Nobody is under it to say otherwise.
